propositions: Clients running rebar CLI without a local repo checkout encounter broken cross-references in packaged guides because internal links use consumer-relative paths (e.g., review-policy.md, ../CONTRIBUTING.md) that do not resolve in repo-less environments

The commit-trailer format specification (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) lacks a CLI-discoverable home and is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help with no guidance pointing there

All packaged author guides must repoint dangling references to use either sibling guide references via rebar explain <topic> or canonical hosted URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/…) to ensure repo-less client resolution
A guard test must assert no packaged _guides/*.md contains consumer-relative link targets, permitting only https://, http://, intra-document anchors, or mailto: URLs to prevent future regression
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring hardcodes the guide list (plan/review) and must be updated to include commit-trailer, while the dynamic dispatch already reads AUTHOR_GUIDES
The new commit-ticket-trailer.md packaged guide must quote EXPECTED_FORMAT verbatim with a drift-pinned test, and include self-check prose referencing rebar verify-commit-ticket
